input.quote: The Servicer will not be obligated to provide, license or assign its processes, procedures, models, servicing software or other applications to any Successor Servicer or any third party, or provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment or a confidentiality agreement or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies.
input.rationale: There is no walk-away problem: nothing assigns our IP or the Receivables data to Cellco, the Receivables are expressly marked as "owned by the Issuer" (p0375), the Receivable Files are held for the benefit of the Issuer and Indenture Trustee, and no joint ownership is created. However, the Agreement fails the fallback: the Servicer prepares and delivers Monthly Investor Reports, Receivable Files, accounts and records for us, yet we receive no licence at all in them, while Section 7.5(b) expressly preserves the Servicer's processes, models and servicing software (which satisfies the fallback element allowing Vendor to keep its generic tools and know-how). The Servicer's access to our data is already confined to servicing purposes (p0146), so the only gap is the deliverables licence. We therefore add one short subsection to Section 9.4 granting the Issuer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those deliverables for its business, without disturbing the Servicer's retained tools.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for the Issuer to use, modify and sublicense the Servicer's reports, files and records.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no licence to the reports, files and records the Servicer prepares for us, while Section 7.5(b) preserves the Servicer's own processes and software. We have added a short perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those deliverables for our business, which is our fallback position and leaves the Servicer's tools untouched.

ops.text: License to Reports and Records. The Servicer grants the Issuer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Monthly Investor Reports, the Receivable Files and the other reports, accounts and records prepared or maintained by the Servicer under this Agreement for the Issuer's business purposes.
